parsed.reason: Every fact checks out against the research notes. OSP is free, publicly funded CBT for adults 18+ in Ontario with depression or anxiety. No health card or family doctor is needed, self-referral is accepted, and the referral form is at ontariohealth.ca/osp. Affordable Therapy Services from $50 on a sliding scale and the Psychology Today Canadian directory are both in the notes. Calling 911 or going to the ER is settled knowledge in Canada and is mentioned lightly. Nothing is invented. It doesn't wrongly ask which city, and it closes with a friendly question. It is warm and gives real ways in. Some phrasing reads like a resource sheet ('publicly funded CBT for adults 18+ living in Ontario', 'Find your local network and the referral form at'), so it is a little more brochure than friend text.
